predecessor_evidence.interpretation: Historical negative/mixed v1 evidence remains unchanged. V2 is a new prospective study, not a rescue or retroactive modification of v1.

primary_question: Under strictly causal preprocessing and matched validation-only controls, does the FI-JEPA representation improve one-quarter-ahead GDP-growth proxy prediction relative to raw-context controls on the frozen statsmodels macrodata task?

preprocessing.timestamp_policy: invalid timestamps fail closed; no forward/backward timestamp imputation
preprocessing.feature_policy: numeric conversion followed by within-asset forward fill only; leading unfillable rows are dropped
preprocessing.resampling_policy: past-only forward fill; bidirectional interpolation forbidden
preprocessing.normalization_policy: fit mean/std on training rows only and reuse unchanged for validation/test

representation_design.ablation_identifiability_rule: The full model must execute at least two sequential predictor stages. Any operator-split ablation must produce a mechanically distinct forward graph before outcome access.
representation_design.interpretation_limit: A one-stage monolithic ablation is not a pure mechanism test if capacity differs materially; capacity must be reported and the comparison kept descriptive unless a matched monolithic control is implemented.

split_policy.final_test_access: single pass after all hashes, controls, seeds, metrics, and thresholds are frozen

required_controls.name: raw_context_ridge
required_controls.selection: alpha in [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0], selected by validation MSE only

required_controls.name: raw_context_hist_gradient_boosting
required_controls.selection: validation-only 2 x 2 x 2 grid over max_leaf_nodes=[7,15], learning_rate=[0.03,0.1], l2_regularization=[0,1], max_iter=200, early_stopping=false

required_controls.name: capacity_matched_direct_mlp
required_controls.selection: hidden width chosen analytically for closest trainable-parameter count; validation selects the best epoch checkpoint only
required_controls.optimization: same seed, epochs, batch size, AdamW learning rate, and weight decay as full FI-JEPA
required_controls.capacity_rule: relative trainable-parameter gap must be <= 0.10 or execution fails closed

primary_metric.name: test_regression_mse
primary_metric.success_rule: Mean relative MSE improvement must be at least 5% AND the paired five-seed bootstrap 95% interval for the MSE delta must have upper endpoint below 0.
primary_metric.uncertainty_boundary: With five seeds this interval is descriptive rather than definitive significance evidence.

authorization_blockers: run the full repository test suite on this exact branch and resolve engineering failures without changing the frozen scientific decision rule
independent pre-outcome review of the protocol, causal preprocessing, controls, source identities, and claim boundary
if no_operator_split is to support an inferential mechanism claim, add a <=10% capacity-matched monolithic control; otherwise retain it as descriptive only
only after review, change status to FROZEN_PRE_OUTCOME_AUTHORIZED and execution_authorized=true in a dedicated authorization change before any test-outcome access
claim_boundary: Any v2 result is limited to this small public macrodata benchmark. It does not establish trading alpha, profitability, broad financial-market generalization, causality, or state-of-the-art forecasting.

control_family_selection.rule: For each seed, select the strongest raw-context control using validation MSE only, then expose that already-selected control exactly once to the test split.

freeze.raw_macrodata_canonicalization: statsmodels.datasets.macrodata raw table serialized with pandas to_csv(index=False, lineterminator='\n', float_format='%.17g')
